title: Ascending chain condition for quasi-coherent submodules on a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space) and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Every increasing sequence $\mathcal F_1\subseteq\mathcal F_2\subseteq\dots\subseteq\mathcal F$ of quasi-coherent submodules is eventually constant. In particular every nonempty set of quasi-coherent submodules of $\mathcal F$, and every nonempty set of quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$, has a maximal element for inclusion.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y8 (lemma-acc-coherent); the maximal-element form is how the proofs of Proposition 088C and Theorem 088E use it

proof.text: Use compactness and the affine-open basis to choose a finite affine open cover. Local Noetherianness gives Noetherian section rings on every covering open.

Coherence gives finite section modules on every covering affine, by coherent_affine_sections_finite. Evaluate each subobject arrow and take its linear-map range; factorization of subobject inclusions makes these maps monotone.

For a monotone sequence of quasi-coherent subobjects, use finite-module ACC on each affine. Take the finite supremum of the stabilization indices. Section images at every later index agree on the cover. The affine-cover equality lemma gives global equality.

The chain condition on the subtype of quasi-coherent subobjects gives WellFoundedGT by Mathlib wellFoundedGT_iff_monotone_chain_condition. Its maximal-element theorem applied to membership in the given nonempty set gives a maximal subobject.

Independently, apply ideal ACC over the Noetherian section rings to a monotone sequence of IdealSheafData. Take the same kind of finite supremum and use Mathlib Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top to obtain equality globally. Convert this chain condition to WellFoundedGT and take a maximal element of the nonempty set. No coherence of the structure sheaf is required.

lean.statement: theorem noetherian_quasicoherent_submodules (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) : (∀ (G : ℕ → Subobject F), Monotone G → (∀ n, (G n : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).IsQuasicoherent) → ∃ n, ∀ m, n ≤ m → G m = G n) ∧ (∀ S : Set (Subobject F), S.Nonempty → (∀ G ∈ S, (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).IsQuasicoherent) → ∃ G ∈ S, ∀ H ∈ S, G ≤ H → H = G) ∧ (∀ S : Set X.IdealSheafData, S.Nonempty → ∃ I ∈ S, ∀ J ∈ S, I ≤ J → J = I)
